title: [Feature Request] Can you please bring in a battery status for OrangeLink into the Medtronic driver ?
symptom: User requests a battery status display for OrangeLink in the Medtronic driver, without having to disconnect and scan with nRF Connect.
fix: Enable battery display in settings to see battery level in 'RileyLink Stats' dialog; developer will add display on main MDT tab.
evidence_quote: At the moment if you enable battery display in settings, you can see battery level in "RileyLink Stats" dialog.
